turns.text: That's completely understandable. Glad to hear your back is still feeling 100%! How are things going with your neighbor's vegetable garden? Have they started planting anything new for the spring?

turns.text: They're getting the soil ready right now. Since we're in Portland, the weather is still a bit unpredictable, but they're planning out their rows. It's making me wish we had a green thumb!

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It definitely takes some patience! Well, I hope you and Grace thoroughly enjoy the sci-fi show tonight. Let me know if you need anything else to help wrap up your day.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I think we're all set. I'm just going to finish up grading a few science papers and then call it a day. Talk to you tomorrow!
